Package gnu.x11.keysym

Class Greek

java.lang.Object
gnu.x11.keysym.Greek
public class Greek extends Object
Greek-specific keyboard symbols. Imported from XK_GREEK section of /usr/include/X11/keysymdef.h. Note that byte 3 = 0x07.
